_comment: Overrides Artifacts' own trinkets/entities/default.json to drop the hand/glove slot.
Artifacts grants two glove slots, hand/glove and offhand/glove, and both accept exactly the
same items (#artifacts:slot/hands) - so the one that refused everything was not an item
eligibility problem. hand/glove is the slot whose visibility runs through the pack's own
TrinketsCombinedSlotVisibilityMixin, which is the same override that cost hand/ring its slot
backing in v4.3.2. Only offhand/glove is built alwaysVisible by Trinkets and so is reliably
The replace flag is what makes the removal actually happen, and v4.3.3 shipped without it.
Trinkets reads these through ResourceManager.listResourceStacks, so it sees every pack's copy
of this path and unions them all. Overriding the file therefore added our list alongside the
Artifacts one rather than replacing it, and hand/glove survived into the game. replace clears
everything accumulated for these entities before adding the list below.
That clear is only safe because of ordering. Entity files are processed alphabetically, so the
single file ahead of default.json is crittersandcompanions.json, and it grants chest/necklace,
which is listed below anyway. Everything else sorts after and re-adds itself: frostiful and
wildernature capes, the inmis backpack, nbidal18_rings, the scorchful hat. A new file named to
sort before crittersandcompanions would be wiped without warning, so do not add one.
